title: msg inbox
description: Dispatcher: read messages workers posted via sm_msg_report (oldest first). clear=true consumes them after reading.

clear.description: print the reports, then empty the inbox (consume them)

unread.description: show only reports newer than the read cursor, then advance it (non-destructive; reports stay in the inbox)

number.description: show only the most recent N reports

newestFirst.description: newest report first; default oldest first

watch.description: block until the next report lands, then print + exit
